**Description**
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Are you excited about building cloud desktop experiences used by organizations worldwide? Amazon WorkSpaces delivers fully managed Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions from the AWS Cloud enabling customers to provision secure high-quality cloud desktops accessible from any device. Our team tackles complex distributed systems challenges to bring a native desktop experience to modern form factors while making provisioning and management simple and cost-effective for IT administrators.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on the WorkSpaces team you will own features end-to-end from design through development, testing, deployment, and operations. You will work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS contributing to platform services system-level components and the layers in between. If you enjoy solving meaningful technical problems in scalable systems and care about the real-world impact your software has on customers this is the role for you.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design implement test and deploy software features across the full development lifecycle for Amazon WorkSpaces producing high-quality maintainable code that others on the team can extend.
* Collaborate with senior engineers product managers and cross-functional partners across AWS to define technical solutions that address customer needs and align with long-term architectural strategy.
* Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes that continuously improve system reliability and performance.
* Coach other engineers through code reviews and design discussions sharing knowledge that raises the technical bar across the team.
* Evaluate new technologies and approaches recommending adoption where appropriate to improve scalability security or developer productivity within the WorkSpaces platform.

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, implement, test, and deploy software features across the full development lifecycle for Amazon WorkSpaces, producing high-quality, maintainable code that others on the team can extend.

You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics from a feature you shipped earlier in the week then join a design discussion with teammates about a new provisioning workflow. Your work spans the full stack and you regularly interact with product managers and partner teams to ensure what you build solves real customer problems.

This role is ideal for
**mid-level engineers**

**real-time systems, C++, and cloud-native development**
.

* Write clean, efficient C++ and Python code for both on-prem and cloud-hosted environments.
* Work with structured data formats like XML, JSON, HTML, and XSLT — and learn how they power News industry standards.
* Collaborate in a scrum team crafting solutions and delivering new features.
* Be responsible for your code by writing automated tests, participating in code reviews, and supporting production systems.
* Help automate deployment, upgrades, and maintenance using modern DevOps tools and practices (CI/CD, containerization, telemetry, instrumentation).
* Occasionally provide on-call support for critical systems (we keep it reasonable).

* Solid experience with C/C++ on Linux and real-time systems.
* Practical experience in using IP-based protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, HTTPS, etc.).
* Familiarity with unit testing, especially using Google Test.
* Understanding of network protocols and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and container orchestration.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and communicate clearly.

**Bonus**

* Hands-on experience with Python, Google Test framework, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, or Terraform.
* Knowledge of NewsMLG2 or similar standards and experience implementing a standard format at speed.

* Impact: Your work helps deliver critical news to millions in real time.
* Growth: Learn from expert engineers and expand your skills across cloud, data, and resilient systems.
* Culture: We value curiosity, ownership, and teamwork. You’ll work in a globally distributed team that supports each other.
* Flexibility: Hybrid work options and a balanced work-life environment.
